body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its compact clamshell phone ‘Aloha’ during CES 2008 (Booth #8214, Central Hall, Las Vegas Convention Center).

The Aloha by LG is an ultra-compact phone that keeps consumers completely connected to the world around them. While at work or play, its two-way speakerphone and voice-activated dialing enable hands-free mobile calling.

Consumers can use its text messaging to update friends and family with the latest changes in their busy schedule. And its mobile Web and full-color internal LCD enable consumers to view news and events in vivid detail quickly and easily.
